title: B2B Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**
RD Info Global Solutions | RDIGS, founded in 2016 and formerly known as RD Info Solutions, is a human-driven and technology-powered lead and demand generation company. RDIGS partners with businesses to help generate, nurture, and convert leads into measurable revenue. The company’s expert teams design and execute multi-channel strategies that align with clients’ growth objectives. RDIGS emphasizes scalable planning, data-driven decision-making, and close collaboration to deliver high-quality B2B demand generation outcomes for its clients.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site B2B Content Writer role based in Pune. The B2B Content Writer will create clear, engaging, and conversion-focused content tailored for business audiences, including website pages, landing pages, email campaigns, case studies, blogs, and marketing collateral. The role involves closely collaborating with marketing, sales, and demand generation teams to understand target industries, buyer personas, and campaign goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include researching industry trends and client offerings, developing content outlines, writing and editing copy, optimizing content for lead generation, and maintaining consistent brand voice across all channels. The B2B Content Writer will also support content performance analysis and ongoing improvements based on campaign metrics and feedback.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong B2B writing skills for web pages, blogs, email campaigns, landing pages, and marketing collateral.
* Ability to research target markets, buyer personas, and industry trends to create relevant, insightful content.
* Experience in content planning, editorial calendars, and aligning content with demand generation goals.
* Proficiency in proofreading and editing to ensure clarity, accuracy, and consistent brand tone.
* Understanding of digital marketing concepts such as lead generation, nurturing workflows, and basic SEO.
* Comfort working closely with marketing and sales teams to translate business objectives into content.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Prior experience in B2B or SaaS lead and demand generation environments is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Pune and adapt to a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.

title: Content Writer
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Content Writer who can create well-researched, engaging and

search-optimized content for a US-focused B2B audience. The role will work closely with the

marketing, SEO and engineering teams to build organic visibility, industry authority and qualified

inbound enquiries.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Write SEO-optimized blogs, articles, service pages, landing pages and website content.

• Develop detailed project case studies by coordinating with internal engineering and project

teams.

• Create content around MEP engineering, architecture, construction, franchise development

and related topics.

• Research industry trends, competitor content, keywords and audience questions before

writing.

• Optimize content for SEO, answer-focused search and AI or generative search visibility.

• Use clear headings, FAQs, direct answers, comparisons and tables where relevant.

• Refresh existing website content based on performance and content gaps.

• Create thought-leadership and expert-led content with inputs from internal subject-matter

experts.

• Support LinkedIn, social media content and marketing campaigns when required.

• Maintain content calendars and ensure timely delivery.

**Skills Required:**

• Strong written English, grammar and storytelling skills.

• Strong research ability and comfort with technical B2B topics.

• Good understanding of SEO content writing and search intent.

• Familiarity with AEO, GEO or AI search optimization is preferred.

• Ability to simplify technical concepts without losing accuracy.

• Experience writing for US audiences is preferred.

• Familiarity with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console or similar tools is a plus.

• Comfort using AI tools for research and productivity while maintaining originality and

quality.

**What we are looking for:**

Someone who understands audience, search intent, problem, insight, solution and conversion, not someone who writes only around keywords.

Please share your Resume and Work Sample / Portfolio on devika.m@ny-engineers.com

title: Functional Engineer Reporting
description:
**About AkzoNobel**
Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.
  
  
For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
  
  
© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Data and Reporting team is focused on unlocking the value of data as it exists within AkzoNobel systems. We're an eclectic team of data-oriented doers who love to take on new challenges, are always learning, and looking for ways to improve decision-making.
  
  
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**
Design, develop, test, and implement IT solutions and processes in IT systems like applications, platforms and networks through IT changes, projects in line with global Information Technology (IT) and security guidelines, to support company business requirements to create company value.
  
  
The
**Functional**
**Engineer in Application Delivery**
is responsible for detailing design and hardwiring business requirements as per Architectural and Security guidelines. This is done through projects, changes and increasingly more through Agile Devops teams. This requires high quality Stories (change specifications) and projects changes which will allow Engineers and/or Developers to translate into code/configuration. The Functional Engineer sees to properly coordinate, review, approve and execute stories/project changes and has an active role monitoring status, in (unit)testing and change management once developed, including organizing sign-off after testing.
  
  
The Functional Engineer has an active role in the preparation and execution of the actual changes together with our partners and external consultants where applicable.
  
  
On request, a Functional Engineer can be asked to be involved in solving urgent high priority incidents and plays a role in process improvements alongside with business.
  
  
Depending on the domain and the progress of IT Fusion in our organization, the work is either done in agile teams under the leadership of a Scrum Master or in the case of a waterfall under the leadership of the Project Manager. Depending on the seniority of the Engineer, he/she will also assume these project management activities as a role or will take lead in delivery of end-to-end changes.
  
  
**Key Activities**
**Story specification**
Translate business requirements into clear detailed designs. Own and develop high quality Stories (change specifications) and project changes for Engineers and External Consultants to then translate into code or config and a proposal on a change implementation.
  
  
**Development & delivery**
Guide, coordinate and oversee the preparation and execution and implementation of the (project) changes and the development of the code/config of Stories. Ensure that all partners follow established standards (process- & documentation standards, coding and testing standards, naming conventions etc.). Review, Approve and control the implementation and/or embedding of new, enhancements and/or modifications of applications, systems and/or solutions.
  
  
This results in building sustainable and stable first-time right solutions in a very collaborate team spirit (also with external service providers) and in an engaging way with stakeholders and consumers of the solutions. Solutions are built according to the Architectural and Security principles and changes are timely & adequately prepared & documented and/or code works as intended.
  
  
**Testing**
Own testing of changes or stories, and/or actively oversee testing by business. Develop test scripts, examine test outcomes, sign off for unit testing and coordinate business sign off for Application Delivery related testing. Contribute to test planning and test management for a specific release.
  
  
Resulting in, changes and/or code are properly and timely tested.
  
  
**Incident management**
Perform functional or technical problem analysis in case of incidents or issues as needed depending on the severity of the problem. Perform root cause analysis, document these and share findings. Deploy (or oversee deployment) of updates and fixes. To ensure that issues, incidents and problems are swiftly and effectively resolved.
  
  
**Process management and improvement**
Monitor, guard, test and analyze that the use and security of applications and systems regarding the functional and performance aspects are in line with the agreed performance indicators, and if necessary, take measures. Actively contribute to process improvement: e.g. tool development, dashboard/insight development and visualization, script automation. Has a good view of the technical state of the application (technical debt) and regularly discuss and works seamlessly together with the (domain)Architect to develop plans to resolve the technical debt.
  
  
Resulting in, available and optimally performing applications and IT infrastructure for the business and, DevOps process, tooling and dashboards are continuously improving.
  
  
**Project support**
Support a project manager by taking ownership of specific project deliverables (specifications, config, testing, etc). Define, plan, manage and participate in assigned project deliverables from the own functional or technical domain, in accordance with the IT project manager and involved business project owners. Resulting in, efficient and effective realization of project deliverables.
  
  
**Experience**
**Business partnering**
with all the stakeholders in the organization to determine opportunities / requirements for Data analytics solutions that can drive revenue growth, operational efficiencies, customer value etc.
  
  
**Project Management:**
Should be able to independently manage several projects, track actions and reach out to stakeholders when needed.
  
  
**Solution design & development:**
Develop new solution using BI Tools (Power BI)
  
  

* Translate business logic to technical calculations that will help the technical team to build the metrics
* Fetch and embed data from SAP HANA, BW, Azure SQL, Excel, flat files, Sharepoint list etc.
* Perform data transformation, engineering, [joint, exclusion, enrichment, pivoting, etc.] using SQL, Databricks Pyspark(Good to have)
* Integrate & prepare multi sourced - complex data efficiently
* Automate tools/ data flow using best practices in collaboration with internal teams and Data Engineers.

**Improve and maintain existing solutions:**

* Suggest technical improvements / automation ideas for existing Analytics solutions
* Test and ensure compatibility of existing solutions upon new software version release
* Improve and safeguard dashboards performance (latency, downtime)
* Educate and train a variety of stakeholders about the dashboard technicalities & features
* Keep detailed technical documentation complete and up to date

**Academic and professional background:**

* Bachelors or master’s degree in analytics, Business, or finance from a premier institute
* Minimum 6+ years work experience in Data analytics & visualization roles in a global or multinational environment

**Skillset and professional experience:**

* Highly skilled in communication and collaboration, with experience in working with cross-functional teams and presenting data insights to executive stakeholders.
* Capable of working independently to identify business problems and opportunities that can be addressed through data analysis.
* Highly skilled in data analysis and modeling, with the ability to work with large datasets and complex data structures.
* Exceptional in creating visualizations in PowerBI (+DAX) that effectively communicate complex data insights to non-technical audience.
* Proficient in using SQL, and other data analysis tools.
* Good to have skills such as PySpark for Databricks, Python or R, with experience in data wrangling, data cleaning, and statistical analysis. Has a deep understanding of data modeling and can work with complex data structures.
* Experience in developing and implementing predictive models to forecast business outcomes and support decision-making.
* Excellent Presentation & PowerPoint skills

title: Engineer - V&V
description: What You’ll DoEaton announced, on June 11, 20206, the intent to combine its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) with a new company. We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.This position is part of the Vehicle Controls Product Line engineering team and supports verification and validation of rugged operator-control products for on-road and off-road vehicles and commercial mobile equipment. Products include rocker, toggle, push-button, key-lock, and rotary switches; indicators; multiplexed keypads and electronic switch modules; operator-control and human-machine interface products; and vehicle input/output modules. title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
So, what’s the role all about?
  
  
NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Every tool we launch needs a great front door, and that is the Support Helpdesk.
  
  
As Support Helpdesk in the SPARK team, you will be the first point of contact for colleagues using the AI tools SPARK builds: answering questions, triaging issues, fixing what you can, and escalating what you cannot, with clear evidence. You are an advanced software engineer at heart, so you can go beyond scripts and FAQs: read logs, test an API call, spot a configuration or prompt problem, and explain it in simple terms.
  
  
You will be the primary helpdesk owner, supported by a backup or rotating colleague for cover, and you will partner closely with the AI Architects & Builders and the Change Management & Evangelist. What you learn from users will shape what SPARK builds and improves next.
  
  
How will you make an impact?
  
  
You will own the user support experience for SPARK solutions, keeping colleagues productive and feeding what you learn back into the tools.
  
  
Support Our Users
  
  

* Be the first point of contact for user questions, access requests, and issues, through the team’s support channels
* Triage, prioritise, and track every request through to resolution in the ticketing system, with clear and timely updates to users
* Troubleshoot technical issues by reviewing logs, testing API calls, checking configurations and prompts, reproducing problems, and fixing what is within your reachEscalate to the AI Architects & Builders with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and impact, so engineers can act fast

Build Knowledge
  
  

* Create and maintain FAQs, how-to guides, and a searchable knowledge base for every SPARK solution
* Document known issues, workarounds, and runbooks, and keep them current as solutions change
* Help onboard new users and groups, working with the Change Management & Evangelist on guides and training materials

Spot Patterns and Improve
  
  

* Analyse ticket trends to identify recurring issues, usability gaps, and training needs, and report them to the Change Management & Evangelist and the AI Architects & Builders
* Track support metrics such as volume, response and resolution times, user satisfaction, and top issues, and share regular summaries
* Capture user feedback and feature requests for the product backlog
* Create real time dashboard for requestor to have visibility into progress

Automate and Cover
  
  

* Use scripts and AI tools to automate repetitive support tasks such as triage, routing, FAQ answers, and reporting
* Coordinate with your backup or rotating support colleague to maintain coverage during absences and busy periods
* Help monitor usage and platform health, and raise alerts on anything that looks wrong

Have you got what it takes?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 4-8 years of experience as a software engineer, or in L2/L3 application or technical support for software products
* Hands-on technical skills: scripting or programming (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar), SQL, REST APIs, tools such as Postman, and reading application logs
* Experience with ticketing and service management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, and the patience to guide non-technical users clearly
* Excellent written communication: clear, friendly, and concise answers and documentation
* Everyday use of generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot, and an understanding of how AI answers can go wrong
* An ownership mindset: you stay with an issue until it is resolved or handed over cleanly
* Fluency in English
* Ability to work support hours that cover the regions the team serves (working pattern to be confirmed)

You will have an advantage if you also have:
  
  

* Experience supporting internal AI tools, chatbots, or agent platforms
* Experience building automations or lightweight bots for support
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, and with basic CI/CD
* Experience with knowledge base tools and writing technical documentation
* Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS support
* Experience supporting users across multiple time zones

What’s in it for you?
  
  
SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.
  
  
Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!
  
  
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

Tech Manager, Engineering, CX

Individual Contributor

*NICE Ltd. title: Business Continuity Analyst
description:

This role is responsible for assisting in the implementing the global Business Continuity Program's strategies and processes across S+N sites and business units to ensure a site or function can recover quickly and effectively from business interrupting incidents. The Business Continuity Analyst will work directly with business teams to provide BCM professional practices including, but not limited to BC Education and Awareness; Business Impact Analyses (BIA); Risk Assessments; BC Plan development; Crisis Management support; Training & Exercise support; program maintenance; etc. This role reports to the Director, Global Business Resiliency & Continuity Management.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Deliver Business Continuity & Resiliency SME consultative and customer service to global matrix business teams : Facilitate Business Impact Analyses and BC Risk Assessments; support site and function team leaders in BC Plan development and maintenance; conduct BC Plan reviews; provide guidance for annual BC Plan exercises; educate site and function teams on BC Program concepts.
* Assist with the training, configuration, implementation and maintenance of S+N's Emergency Notification System (Everbridge) to authorized administrators globally.
* Assist in the development, review, and enhancement of BC program policies, processes, guidelines, and tools.
* Assist with compiling program governance and management reports for the BCM Steering Committee, Operations Leadership, Crisis Management Team, Audit, etc.
* Collaborate with various S+N supporting teams on integrated programs, projects and initiatives (DR, ERM, HSE, Supply Chain, Facilities, Communications, etc.).

title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
description:
**Job Summary**
This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
  
  
**Competencies**
Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
  
  
Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.
  
  
Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.
  
  
Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.
  
  
Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
  
  
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
  
  
Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
  
  
Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
  
  
**Resposibilities**

* Develop embedded fuel systems controls software per requirements
* Follow all Cummins internal software processes while developing embedded fuel system controls software
* Modify existing software implementation to support the software change
* Verify and document evidence of the software change functioning correctly
* Solve the software related problems by determining the root cause
* Generate a solution to fix the problem identified and verify on test bench
* Highlight software integration changes to peers in a timely manner
* Support global software team to deliver software for global engine programs
* Align with global software development functional excellence practices
* The work will include development in both ‘C’ code as well as in Simulink models.Other tools used for development will include the use of a Cummins proprietary data dictionary and build tool, configuration management tools as well as test tools (oscilloscopes, frequency generators, debuggers, etc.…)

**Skills – Functional/Technical**

* MTech or BTech Electrical Engineering or computer science with embedded controls development focus preferred
* 7 to 9 years industry experience or equivalent academic experience in development of automotive controls software
* Experience with MATLAB and Simulink for model-based development.
* Experience with programming in C or other imperative and procedural languages.
* Understanding of diesel engines, mechanical systems, especially fuel systems and air handling systems is a plus
* Good communication and presentation skills required for documenting software design, test results and observations
* Experience or familiarity with microprocessor based embedded control system development
* Understanding of AUTOSAR

title: Senior Engineer Application
description:
Woodward is the global leader in the design, manufacturing, and service of energy conversion and control solutions for the aerospace and industrial equipment markets. Together with our customers, we are enabling the path to a cleaner, decarbonized world. Our innovative fluid, combustion, electrical, propulsion and motion control systems perform in some of the world’s harshest environments.
  
  
At Woodward we have created a culture that appreciates and values the contributions of every member. We are a global team of curious, innovative problem-solvers who commit our knowledge, resources and technical expertise to the challenges associated with reducing emissions, enabling alternative energy sources and increasing efficiency, always innovating for a better future.
  
  
We are committed to creating a great workplace for all team members. Our company and its members are committed to acting with integrity, being respectful and accountable to one another, and staying humble and driven, while maintaining the highest professional and ethical standards.
  
  
We are steadfastly committed to attracting the best talent across our communities, creating a rewarding workplace. Together we are fulfilling our purpose to design and deliver energy control solutions our partners count on to power a clean future.
  
  
**We are looking for Senior Engineer Application for our team at Pune or Gurgaon location**
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Application Development:**
Fully proficient with application / calibration software (INCA / Toolkit) and associated operator interface/HMI software to support test setups, debug recommendations, and software changes. The candidate will be responsible for engine control system development and will be working with engine OEMs or aftermarket customers for development of engines or upgradation of existing solutions. The candidate will be involved right form working on technical solutions including system architecture, component sizing, harness design, supporting customer during engine / Genset calibration and testing using calibration tools. The candidate will be responsible for reviewing customers’ validation data as per Woodward’s application management process, conducting design review and application sign off with customer.
  
  
Advanced Problem Solving: Identifies and resolves intricate technical challenges by analyzing multiple information sources and applying innovative solutions.
  
  
Application Processes: Supports the commercial group in proposal creation, technical support of commercial offers, and customer presentations. Creates product specifications, software and application literature for Minor Scope Projects/Systems.
  
  
Project Management: Leads small to medium sized engineering projects, coordinating resources and timelines to achieve project objectives.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Guides the design and implementation of complex application systems, ensuring adherence to best practices and architectural standards.
  
  
Key Skills:
  
  
Technical Proficiency: Expertise in engine development cycle (large or small engines) with experience in either combustion development or engine control system, should be expert in using calibration tools like INCA or Toolkit. The candidate can possess experience in engine development either with Diesel or Gas as a fuel.
  
  
Effective Communication: Proficient in conveying difficult or sensitive information and fostering consensus.
  
  
Cross functional Collaboration: Skilled in working with multiple global teams and subject matter experts, internal and external, to build consensus and drive successful outcomes across multiple projects.
  
  
Complex Problem Solving: Ability to solve sophisticated technical issues through analytical judgment. Demonstrates the ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision.
  
  
Mentorship and Support: Acts as a resource for junior engineers, providing guidance, training, and knowledge sharing to enhance team expertise.
  
  
Market and Competitive Awareness: Knowledge of market differentiators and competitive landscape to drive strategic initiatives.
  
  
Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze multiple sources of information to make informed strategic decisions.
  
  
Best Practices Knowledge: In depth understanding of industry best practices and their application within the organization. Promotes and implements process improvements
  
  
Documentation and Record Keeping: Skilled in creating, maintaining and adhering to accurate technical requirements, documentation and records.
  
  
Applying Standards: Working knowledge of standards and the ability to apply complex groupings of standards into projects.
  
  
Candidate should be ready for travel 25% of time.
  
  
Other Qualifications:
  
  
4 Year Bachelors degree AND 8+ years equivalent experience

title: Learning & Organizational Development Manager
description:
**Thornton Tomasetti**
applies engineering and scientific principles to solve the world’s challenges. An independent organization of creative thinkers and innovative doers collaborating from offices worldwide, our mission is to bring our clients' ideas to life and, in the process, lay the groundwork for a better, more resilient future. We provide support and opportunities to our employees to achieve their full potential and cultivate a rewarding career.
  
  
**Your Role**
A commitment to challenging our people to grow, coupled with our inherent curiosity, drives Thornton Tomasetti to be a learning organization and, increasingly, a teaching one. Recognizing that most growth comes through active engagement in on-the-job experiences, proactive independent learning, and relationships, our Learning and Organizational Development (L+OD) group focuses on shortening learning curves and helping to create common frameworks across the organization related to four major skillsets: Technical, Management, Winning Work, and Leadership. We often provide resources, structure, additional scaffolding, logistical coordination, and other support to empower TT staff to teach/coach/mentor and learn-from one another. In our work, we emphasize curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement in the efficiency, effectiveness, and scalability of our programs through innovation.
  
  
The Learning and Organizational Development Manager will support our staff around the globe in accelerating their growth to more fully reach their potential as well-rounded professionals, with a particular focus on our rapidly growing presence in Asia (India, Vietnam, Australia, etc.). The person in this role will report to the Director of Learning and Organizational Development and collaborate closely with a wide range of staff around the world including program participants, subject matter experts, program executive sponsors, firm matrix leaders, and other members of Human Resources team.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Holistically manage learning programs aligned with the firm’s global efforts and vision, including conducting needs assessments, aligning learning objectives with business needs, partnering with subject matter experts, leading team members, and collaborating across stakeholder groups.
* Lead the design, development, assessment, and continuous improvement of learning collateral across modalities including customizing material for specific audiences, documenting procedures, reviewing others’ work, and serving as a liaison with continuing education accreditation organizations.
* Deliver exceptional learning experiences through a combination of facilitation, moderation, publication, and train-the-trainer efforts across programs.
* Manage content, data, and processes in the firm-wide Workday learning management system.
* Provide logistical, data management and analysis, and administrative support for programs.
* Complete other tasks as assigned.

**What You'll Bring**

* Degree (Master’s preferred) in education or a related field.
* 8+ years of progressive learning and development experience including instructional design, use of adult learning theories, delivering training, managing learning programs, train-the-trainer efforts, people management, and influencing senior leaders.
* Significant experience collaborating with people both in India and internationally, preferably within complex global organizations and professional services contexts.
* Strong project management, stakeholder management, and change management skills with the ability to balance long-term vision with operational execution.
* Excellent communication (written and verbal), collaboration, cultural awareness, emotional intelligence (self-management, relationship management, empathy, influence), adaptability, development of trusting relationships, and professional presence.
* Adaptability to participate in real-time communications and activities with team members in the United States and around the globe.
* Proficient at data management/analysis and with Microsoft productivity applications.
* Preferred: experience with Workday Learning, Articulate Storyline, and Camtasia.

title: Lead Quality (Warranty domain)
description:
Lead Quality - Warranty (Field Failure & Complaint Analysis)

**Location:**
Pune / Multiple Plant Locations

**Experience:**
10-12 Years

**Qualification:**
B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering

Role Purpose

The Customer Quality Assurance (CQA) professional will lead technical investigations of customer complaints, warranty returns, and field failures across Electrical & Electronics product lines. The role will focus on identifying scientifically validated root causes, driving corrective and preventive actions, strengthening product and process robustness, and ensuring compliance with automotive quality standards while enhancing customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Complaint & Failure Analysis

* Lead detailed investigations of customer complaints involving mechanical, electrical, electronic, software, material, and system-level failures.
* Analyze customer rejection trends, warranty claims, and defect patterns using quality tools and statistical techniques.
* Correlate field failures with manufacturing, testing, and validation data to identify root causes.
* Perform Measurement System Analysis (MSA) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) studies to validate conclusions.
* Prepare technical reports and support customer discussions for complaint closure.

Quality Standards & Compliance

* Ensure adherence to IATF 16949, ISO 9001, VDA, AIAG, and OEM-specific quality requirements.
* Support customer audits, internal audits, Layered Process Audits (LPA), and compliance reviews.
* Govern the deployment of APQP, PPAP, SPC, MSA, FMEA, Control Plans, and reliability standards.

Structured Problem Solving

* Drive root cause investigations using:
* 8D Methodology
* A3 Problem Solving
* PDCA
* 5 Why Analysis
* Fishbone Diagram
* Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
* Cause & Effect Matrix
* Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Validate corrective actions through testing, simulation, and evidence-based analysis.

Warranty & Reliability Engineering

* Conduct field failure and warranty analysis using:
* Weibull Analysis
* Failure Rate Modeling
* Reliability Growth Analysis
* Life Prediction & Degradation Modelling
* Identify recurring failure modes and reliability risks.
* Collaborate with R&D and Quality teams to address product and process vulnerabilities.

Preventive Quality Improvement

* Integrate customer complaint learnings into:
* DFMEA & PFMEA Updates
* Design Robustness Improvements
* DVP&R Enhancement
* Special Characteristic Identification
* Control Plan Optimization
* Error Proofing (Poka-Yoke) Initiatives
* Drive continuous improvement projects to reduce customer complaints and warranty failures.

Analytics & Reporting

* Develop dashboards and metrics for:
* Customer Complaints
* Warranty Trends
* Product-wise Failure Analysis
* Root Cause Distribution
* Corrective Action Effectiveness
* Provide predictive insights and early warnings on emerging quality concerns.

Cross Functional Collaboration

* Partner with R&D, NPD, Manufacturing Engineering, Plant Quality, Supplier Quality, and Component Development teams.
* Facilitate problem-solving workshops and coach teams on advanced quality methodologies.
* Drive standardization of complaint analysis processes across multiple manufacturing locations.

title: Technical Support Representative

Every day cyberattacks threaten to disrupt hospitals, power grids, financial systems, and the infrastructure we all depend on. At Forescout, we build defenses that keep civilization running smoothly in an increasingly connected world.
  
  
For more than 25 years, Fortune 100 organizations, government agencies, and large enterprises have trusted Forescout as their foundation to manage cyber risk, ensure compliance, and mitigate threats. From power grids and healthcare systems to financial networks and transportation hubs, Forescout protects the critical infrastructure of our modern world.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

As a member of the Technical Support Engineering Team, you will have the opportunity to work closely with and learn from a team of highly skilled security engineers and technical leaders. This is an excellent opportunity for substantial professional growth and to develop your technical skills across a broad range of products.
  
  
In this role, you will assist customers with technical issues to ensure optimal performance of our products and solutions within large and complex customer environments. The TSR is the first point of contact and the first level of support for our customers. You will need a solid understanding of ForeScout products and basic knowledge of the environments in which they are deployed. Under the guidance of Technical Support Leadership, you will take ownership of assigned projects to address and resolve customer issues. Competencies essential to your success in this role include customer service, problem-solving, organization, and time management combined with agility of learning and technical aptitude.

* Good knowledge of enterprise networking environments.
* Experience installing and implementing network access control security solutions is a plus.
* Self-starter with initiative to learn the product in a training class and on-the-job.

title: Lead - Customer Quality
description:
Lead - Customer Quality Assurance

Location: Pune / Multiple Plant Locations

Experience: 10-12 Years

Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering

Role Purpose

The Customer Quality Assurance (CQA) professional will lead technical investigations of customer complaints, warranty returns, and field failures across Electrical & Electronics product lines. The role will focus on identifying scientifically validated root causes, driving corrective and preventive actions, strengthening product and process robustness, and ensuring compliance with automotive quality standards while enhancing customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Complaint & Failure Analysis

* Lead detailed investigations of customer complaints involving mechanical, electrical, electronic, software, material, and system-level failures.
* Analyze customer rejection trends, warranty claims, and defect patterns using quality tools and statistical techniques.
* Correlate field failures with manufacturing, testing, and validation data to identify root causes.
* Perform Measurement System Analysis (MSA) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) studies to validate conclusions.
* Prepare technical reports and support customer discussions for complaint closure.

Quality Standards & Compliance

* Ensure adherence to IATF 16949, ISO 9001, VDA, AIAG, and OEM-specific quality requirements.
* Support customer audits, internal audits, Layered Process Audits (LPA), and compliance reviews.
* Govern the deployment of APQP, PPAP, SPC, MSA, FMEA, Control Plans, and reliability standards.

Structured Problem Solving

* Drive root cause investigations using:
* 8D Methodology
* A3 Problem Solving
* PDCA
* 5 Why Analysis
* Fishbone Diagram
* Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
* Cause & Effect Matrix
* Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Validate corrective actions through testing, simulation, and evidence-based analysis.

Warranty & Reliability Engineering

* Conduct field failure and warranty analysis using:
* Weibull Analysis
* Failure Rate Modeling
* Reliability Growth Analysis
* Life Prediction & Degradation Modelling
* Identify recurring failure modes and reliability risks.
* Collaborate with R&D and Quality teams to address product and process vulnerabilities.

Preventive Quality Improvement

* Integrate customer complaint learnings into:
* DFMEA & PFMEA Updates
* Design Robustness Improvements
* DVP&R Enhancement
* Special Characteristic Identification
* Control Plan Optimization
* Error Proofing (Poka-Yoke) Initiatives
* Drive continuous improvement projects to reduce customer complaints and warranty failures.

Analytics & Reporting

* Develop dashboards and metrics for:
* Customer Complaints
* Warranty Trends
* Product-wise Failure Analysis
* Root Cause Distribution
* Corrective Action Effectiveness
* Provide predictive insights and early warnings on emerging quality concerns.

Cross Functional Collaboration

* Partner with R&D, NPD, Manufacturing Engineering, Plant Quality, Supplier Quality, and Component Development teams.
* Facilitate problem-solving workshops and coach teams on advanced quality methodologies.
* Drive standardization of complaint analysis processes across multiple manufacturing locations.

title: Wealth Regulatory Reporting Operations AVP
description:
The Non-Financial Regulatory Reporting Operations Senior Analyst is a seasoned professional who provides oversight of non-financial regulatory reporting deliverables, maintaining a strong control environment. The Senior Analyst ensures accurate and timely submissions by monitoring workflows, supporting the remediation of identified issues, and facilitating root cause analyses. Role to assist in maintaining and enhancing the reporting control framework, performing reviews of controls and KPIs, and support the team's response to audits, regulatory exams, and internal assurance activities. The Senior Analyst promotes process improvement, supports automation opportunities, and is responsible for coaching junior team members, bridging the gap between operational execution and leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Reporting & Execution:

+ Perform advanced post-submission validation and analysis to identify and resolve issues related to regulatory reporting.
+ Prepare and submit complex non-financial regulatory reports for various jurisdictions and products, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
+ Act as a primary point of contact for coordination with partner units for exceptions and clarifications pertaining to identified issues.
+ Analyze regulatory reporting processes from front to back to identify gaps and improvement opportunities.

* Process Improvement & Projects:

+ Execute assigned elements of the roadmap to improve regulatory reporting operations by streamlining processes, mitigating risks, and enhancing documentation.
+ Drive projects and process improvements, anticipating future regulatory changes and supporting operational alignment within assigned areas.
+ Develop Business Requirements for system-related enhancements and participate in the end-to-end management of their implementation.

* Control & Documentation:

+ Oversee and enhance the control framework for assigned reports, including MCA, audits, and procedure updates.
+ Ensure the completeness of the reporting inventory for their assigned areas by maintaining up-to-date records.
+ Participate in internal and external audit reviews, providing analysis and documentation as required.
+ Serve as an escalation point for junior analysts and contribute to internal training initiatives.
+ Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

* Stakeholder & Governance Support:

+ Participate in regulatory report design reviews with Product and ICRM stakeholders, providing detailed input on data and process requirements.
+ Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, and Technology partners to support integrated reporting solutions.
+ Prepare materials and participate in governance forums to provide updates on specific reports or issues.
+ Prepare information and draft communications for routine regulatory matters as required.

**Qualifications:**

+ 5-8 years of experience in Operations, preferably in a regulatory reporting space.
+ Solid experience in transactional regulatory reporting and a deep understanding of operational processes and controls.
+ Proven experience working with business stakeholders within a cross-functional matrix environment.
+ Hands-on experience with data automation and analytics tools (e.g., Xceptor, Alteryx) is a significant plus; an understanding of prompt development for AI tools is desirable.
+ Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
+ Proficiency with MS Project, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and SharePoint, with experience presenting to stakeholders.
+ Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment, with experience in coaching junior staff.
+ Proficiency in data automation and transformation tools such as Xceptor and Alteryx is highly desirable. Understanding of prompt development for AI tools.

**Education:**

+ Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field. A Master's degree is a plus

You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
  
  
You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.

We are looking for a skilled Regulatory Reporting Professional to support the delivery of technology-enabled regulatory reporting services for digital asset clients. The role focuses on end-to-end report production, data validation, reconciliations, controls, issue management, and regulatory change across U.S. and global reporting obligations. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with clients, onshore teams, technology teams, and operations stakeholders to strengthen reporting accuracy, improve governance, support automation, and build scalable processes aligned with evolving products, entities, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Production & Submissions: Lead regulatory reporting workstreams, including end-to-end preparation, review, and timely submission of U.S. and global filings such as MTL reporting, transaction reporting, financial condition reporting, and capital calculations.
* Broader Banking Regulatory Reporting Exposure: Apply relevant exposure to banking regulatory returns, including capital adequacy, liquidity reporting, ICAAP reporting, balance sheet reporting, and regulatory disclosures, where applicable to the client’s operating model.
* Regulatory Change, Awareness & Reporting Logic: Monitor relevant regulatory developments, interpret reporting instructions, assess data and process impacts, and coordinate timely updates to reporting logic, templates, procedures, controls, and technology workflows.
* Data Sourcing & Analytical Reviews: Perform complex data extraction, validation, variance analysis, and root-cause exception investigations across large datasets to ensure data completeness and integrity.
* Control Governance & Audit Readiness: Embed rigorous quality controls—including maker-checker reviews, clear audit trails, evidence retention, and sign-off protocols—across all reporting cycles.
* Automation & Process Improvement: Identify reporting process inefficiencies and support automation initiatives using tools such as SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
* Analytics & Responsible AI Awareness: Apply awareness of responsible AI and analytics use cases to support anomaly detection, exception analysis, reporting commentary, and workflow monitoring.
* Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment: Provide technical coaching and review support to junior team members while coordinating seamlessly across cross-functional partners and U.S.-based stakeholders.
* Time-Zone Flexibility: Willingness to operate during late/extended hours to ensure seamless hand-offs with U.S.-based stakeholders and meet strict global submission deadlines.
* Al fluency - Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* 2-4 years of relevant work experience in regulatory reporting or financial services.
* Hands-on experience with U.S. regulatory filings, financial condition reporting, customer liability reporting, permissible investments, transaction reporting, and Money Transmitter License (MTL) submissions.
* Master’s degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field is preferred; CA, CPA, CFA, MBA, or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
* Strong end-to-end understanding of regulatory reporting production cycles, data validation, reconciliations, variance analysis, workpaper preparation, and review controls.
* Solid working knowledge of financial statement analysis, regulatory capital concepts, ICAAP reporting, and applicable regulatory compliance frameworks.
* Exposure to banking regulatory reporting frameworks, including capital adequacy, ICAAP reporting, liquidity risk reporting, balance sheet schedules, and regulatory disclosures, would be beneficial.
* Proven ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into business requirements.
* Knowledge of reporting platforms and data tools, along with hands-on experience in SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker, would be an added advantage.
* Awareness of Generative AI tools and workflow automation to support data extraction, exception analysis, and reporting efficiency would be an advantage.
* Strong control mindset, including practical experience with maker-checker reviews, robust audit trails, evidence retention, issue management, and key risk/control testing.
* Advanced data analytics skills, with the ability to query large datasets, perform root-cause analysis on exceptions, and communicate structured findings clearly.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effectively managing relationships across onshore/offshore teams, product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, demonstrating strong ownership, continuous improvement, and agility in adapting to evolving regulatory landscapes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is required. U.S. visa readiness or international travel willingness is preferred but not mandatory.

title: Data Standards Engineer (CDISC) - m/w/d
description:
**Job Responsibilities**

* Support clients and IQVIA as an authority in the use and application of CDISC standards through communication, collaboration, training, and mentorship.
* Partner with project statisticians and programming teams to develop global tools that support project programming needs and the effective implementation of CDISC standards.
* Lead the implementation of productivity tools for IQVIA and clients to improve compliance, efficiency, and timeliness of deliverables.
* Provide training and mentorship in the use of technology and systems, such as metadata repositories, to support IQVIA and clients in the implementation and management of standards.
* Ensure that work delivered to clients meets minimum submission requirements as defined by FDA guidance and other applicable regulatory guidance.
* Guide clients in the interpretation and application of CDISC standards through governance teams.
* Monitor regulatory authority and standards organization websites for updates and communicate relevant changes to IQVIA leadership.
* Contribute to other IQVIA initiatives as a CDISC standards representative.
* Participate in CDISC and other relevant industry standards teams and initiatives.
* Represent IQVIA within the industry as a leader in the use of standards and automation.
* Support leadership in the development and continuous improvement of processes and tools that enable CDISC compliance.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* Extensive knowledge of and experience with CDISC standards, including:

+ SDTM: minimum of 7 years of experience.
+ ADaM: minimum of 5 years of experience.
+ Experience with CDASH is desirable.

* Experience participating in industry standards initiatives or working groups, such as CDISC, HL7, TransCelerate, PHUSE, or similar organizations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret standards and regulatory guidance and apply them appropriately to complex study-specific scenarios.
* Strong attention to detail, with a focus on accuracy, consistency, quality, and compliance with applicable standards and regulatory requirements.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and negotiation skills, including the ability to effectively communicate and defend standards-related recommendations and achieve alignment across different stakeholders.
* Ability to critically evaluate study-specific requirements, challenge proposed approaches where appropriate, and develop pragmatic solutions while maintaining standards compliance.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and make well-reasoned standards-related decisions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within cross-functional and global teams.
* More than 6 years of SAS programming experience is preferred. Experience with additional programming languages, such as R or Python, is advantageous.
* Experience mentoring and developing others in the interpretation and application of CDISC standards.
* Experience supporting submissions to regulatory authorities is preferred.
* Demonstrated interest and active involvement in standards-related activities, either within or outside the company, is expected, for example through CDISC, PHUSE, TransCelerate, or other relevant industry initiatives.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
OpenGov’s Professional Services (PS) team delivers configurable, scalable solutions to state and local governments using Government App Builder (GAB) — OpenGov’s proprietary low-code/no-code application development platform.
  
  
As a Business Application Developer III, you will design, configure, and enhance customer or business specific applications using platform capabilities, configuration, data modeling, workflow automation, and limited scripting.
  
  
**You Will Split Your Time Between**

* Designing and configuring business applications using Government App Builder
* Partnering directly with implementation teams and customers to translate business processes into scalable, automated solutions

This role is ideal for a technically strong problem solver who understands data modeling, workflow logic, and business process design — but does not require heavy full-stack engineering in frameworks such as React, NodeJS, or Java. You will play a key role in delivering high-impact solutions that modernize government operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Application Configuration & Solution Design
* Partner with customers and implementation teams to understand operational workflows and system requirements.
* Translate business requirements into scalable application designs within Government App Builder.
* Configure entities, forms, fields, validations, permissions, dashboards, and reports.
* Apply structured configuration standards to ensure usability, maintainability, and scalability.
* Participate in validation sessions and backlog refinement to align configuration with scope.
* Data Modeling & Architecture
* Design structured data models including entity relationships and cross-table references.
* Apply data modeling best practices including normalization, denormalization trade-offs, and referential integrity.
* Configure field-level validations and data constraints to ensure data quality.
* Support data migrations including field mapping, data transformation, and validation of imported records.
* Troubleshoot data inconsistencies and recommend corrective design patterns.
* Workflow & Process Automation
* Configure approval workflows, routing logic, conditional triggers, and status transitions.
* Implement task assignments, notification rules, and automation components.
* Translate documented decision trees and business rules into platform logic.
* Optimize workflows for compliance, accountability, and audit transparency.
* Ensure scalability of workflows across departments and user roles.
* Business Rule Implementation & Light Scripting
* Implement conditional logic using platform configuration tools.
* Write limited JavaScript (or similar scripting) for:
* Complex validations
* Calculations and derived fields
* Conditional routing
* Data transformation logic
* Maintain clean, reusable logic patterns without overengineering or heavy custom code.
* Integrations & Interoperability
* Configure and validate integrations between Government App Builder and external systems (e.g., ERP, financial systems).
* Support API-based, file-based, event-based or scheduled data exchange patterns.
* Design field mappings and transformation logic to ensure data consistency across systems.
* Document integration patterns and reusable configuration standards.
* Embedded Delivery Support
* Serve as a technical configuration specialist within active customer implementations.
* Partner with Project Managers and Implementation Consultants to deliver configured solutions on time and within scope.
* Troubleshoot configuration issues during UAT and go-live phases.
* Provide technical documentation and knowledge transfer to Customer Success teams.
* Project & Delivery Management
* Contribute technical effort estimates for configuration and automation tasks.
* Manage work across multiple concurrent engagements.
* Ensure timely delivery of configured applications within broader project timelines.
* Maintain high standards of quality, documentation, and responsiveness.

**Required Qualifications**

* Total 3 to 9 years of work experience, including 3+ years of experience in low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Appian, Microsoft Power Apps, Mendix, ServiceNow, etc.) or enterprise application configuration roles.
* Strong understanding of data modeling concepts like entity relationships, referential integrity, normalization, and denormalization.
* Experience designing and implementing business workflows and approval automation.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript or similar scripting language for implementing business rules.
* Ability to translate complex business processes into structured, configurable application logic.
* Experience with integrations (REST APIs, file-based transfers, event based workflows or batch processes).
* Experience integrating third-party APIs and embedding outputs into larger application workflows.
* Strong understanding of security standards (e.g., OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI).
* Strong analytical thinking with systems and process-improvement mindset.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven success working in fast-paced, iterative environments with cross-functional stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in GovTech or public-sector workflows (budgeting, grants management, procurement, capital planning, permitting, capital project management etc.).
* Background in Professional Services, consulting, or customer-facing implementation roles.
* Familiarity with security concepts such as role-based access control and data governance practices.

**Why Join OpenGov Professional Services**
You Will Help Modernize Government Operations By Designing Configurable, Scalable Applications That Replace Spreadsheets, Manual Workflows, And Disconnected Systems. As Part Of Our Professional Services Team, You Will
  
  

* Build impactful solutions without heavy custom engineering overhead.
* Shape best practices for Government App Builder implementations.
* Collaborate with the platform engineering team for improving and enhancing the platform for required capabilities.
* Work with mission-driven teams serving state and local governments.
* Develop expertise in workflow automation, structured data modeling, and enterprise configuration at scale.

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: EV Trainer (Electric Vehicle)
description:
**Role:**
EV Trainer
**Experience:**
1–2 Years
**Qualification:**
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Automobile, Mechatronics or a related discipline
**Engagement:**
Project-based / Contractual / Part-time, depending on project requirements
**Role Purpose**
To deliver practical and classroom-based Electric Vehicle (EV) training to ITI students and support the development of technical skills among students and faculty. The trainer will focus on EV fundamentals, hands-on demonstrations, basic troubleshooting, and industry-relevant technical knowledge.
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver classroom and practical training on Electric Vehicle (EV) technology to ITI students.
* Explain EV fundamentals, vehicle architecture, battery systems, motors, controllers, and charging systems.
* Conduct hands-on demonstrations and practical sessions using EV lab equipment.
* Provide basic training on Battery Management Systems (BMS), power electronics, and automotive electrical systems.
* Demonstrate basic EV maintenance, fault identification, troubleshooting, and safety procedures.
* Assist in developing training presentations, practical exercises, assignments, and assessment materials.
* Support Train-the-Trainer (ToT) programs for ITI instructors and faculty, as required.
* Assist ITI colleges in utilizing EV lab equipment and conducting practical sessions effectively.
* Evaluate student learning outcomes through practical assessments, tests, and demonstrations.
* Maintain training attendance, assessment records, and other project-related documentation.
* Keep training content updated with relevant EV technologies and industry practices.
* Travel to ITI colleges and training centres as required by project needs.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Basic knowledge of Electric Vehicle Technology and EV architecture.
* Understanding of EV batteries and Battery Management Systems (BMS).
* Familiarity with electric motors, motor controllers, and power electronics.
* Basic knowledge of EV charging systems and charging infrastructure.
* Understanding of automotive electrical and electronic systems.
* Ability to perform basic diagnostics, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of EV safety practices, including electrical safety and safe handling of batteries.
* Good communication, presentation, and classroom management skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and deliver hands-on technical training.

**Experience & Qualification**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Automobile, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.
* 1–2 years of relevant experience in EV technology, automotive electrical systems, electrical maintenance, technical training, or a related field.
* Fresh graduates with strong practical EV knowledge and relevant hands-on project experience may also be considered.
* Experience in ITI, Polytechnic, vocational training, or skill development programmes will be an advantage.
* Prior exposure to EV labs, battery systems, charging equipment, or automotive workshops is preferred.
* Good verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts in simple language.
