title: Oracle Support Analyst
description:
**About Us**
We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
  
  
Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
We are looking for an Oracle IT Analyst with hands-on functional experience beyond end-user activities, who is motivated to build and grow a long-term career working with Oracle E-Business Suite.
  
  
In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver stable, scalable, and business-aligned Oracle solutions that enable efficient Procure-to-Pay and Order to Cash operations and continuous process improvement.
  
  
This job is based in
**Pune- Maharashtra - India.**
We provide a flexible working schedule with the option of working
**hybrid**
.
  
  
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from stakeholders and translate them into functional specifications for Oracle E-Business Suite.
* Design, configure, and support Oracle R12 SCM /Distribution modules, including Purchasing, Order Management, iProcurement, Inventory, and iSupplier, Shipping , WMS , Pricing ensuring correct setup of profile options, flexfields, and business rules.
* Map existing (“as-is”) business processes, perform gap analysis, and design optimized (“to-be”) processes aligned with Oracle EBS capabilities.
* Create and maintain functional documentation, including scope documents, functional design documents, use cases, process flows, and user training materials.
* Develop and execute functional test scripts and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
* Provide end-user training and ongoing functional and technical support, including issue resolution and management of Oracle Service Requests (SRs).
* Act as a key liaison between business users and technical teams, ensuring effective communication and successful delivery of IT solutions.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying process efficiencies and system enhancement opportunities.

**For This Role You Will Need**

* University degree in Information Technology, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* 5–7 years of hands-on experience with Oracle E-Business Suite R12, with strong functional expertise in Distribution (Procurement/Order Management) modules.
* Solid understanding of the Procure-to-Pay (P2P)/ Order to Cash(O2C) lifecycle and related supply chain business processes.
* Experience with at least one end-to-end Oracle implementation or multiple Oracle Procurement support projects.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
* Experience creating functional documentation and process maps.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying tables and reading packages.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart**

* Functional knowledge of ASCP AND Manufacturing modules.
* Experience working in a global or cross-functional environment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
* Proactive, pragmatic, and results-oriented mindset.

**Our Commitment to Our People**
Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.
  
  
Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.
  
  
Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!
  
  
**Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging**
At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

title: Product labelling Engineer
description:
**Job Responsibilities:**

Label Development & Execution

* Develop and maintain product labels, packaging labels, IFUs, regulatory markings, and country-specific labeling artifacts.
* Create and update labeling requirements specifications based on regulatory, safety, engineering, and marketing requirements.
* Support new product introductions (NPI), product changes, and sustaining engineering activities.

Change Management

* Drive labeling deliverables through change control processes while meeting project timelines.
* Coordinate with configuration management, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory teams.

Verification & Validation

* Support labeling verification and validation activities.
* Ensure label accuracy, traceability, and consistency across product configurations and regions.
* Participate in Formal Label Reviews (FLR) and documentation reviews.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Biomedical, Systems, Industrial, or related field).

* Knowledge of medical device regulations and standards.
* Experience working in a regulated environment (FDA, ISO 13485, EU MDR).
* Strong documentation and change management skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Technical Support Engineering, Engineer - Structural
description:
We Are
   

  

 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

 You Are
   

  

 Join our Customer Excellence team as a Technical Support Engineer I supporting customers in Japan who use our structural simulation products. Based in India, you will work closely with the Japan support team to assist with technical inquiries related to customers’ real\-world engineering simulation projects and the integration of our software into their design workflows. Depending on the case complexity, you will either support investigations with the Japan team or communicate directly with customers under guidance from experienced engineers.
   

  

 This is an entry\-level or early\-career position designed for an engineer who has a sound foundation in structural mechanics and finite element analysis, an interest in customer\-facing technical work, and a strong willingness to learn. You will develop your technical and customer support capabilities through collaboration with senior engineers and subject matter experts.
   

  

 You will use your engineering knowledge, available technical resources, and AI\-based platforms to diagnose issues, identify solutions, document technical knowledge, and help customers use our products successfully.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Provide first\- or second line technical support for structural simulation products to customers in Japan and to members of the Japan support team.
* Work with the Japan support team to understand customer questions, reproduce reported issues, collect relevant technical information, and investigate potential solutions.
* Depending on the case and your level of technical readiness, communicate directly with customers and manage technical support cases from initial inquiry through resolution.
* Apply fundamental knowledge of structural mechanics, finite element analysis, numerical methods, and simulation techniques to diagnose customer issues.
* Provide clear, accurate, and timely updates to customers and internal stakeholders in English and, where applicable, Japanese \- Fluent speaking, reading, and writing skills are a strong advantage but are not mandatory.
* Recognize when a technical issue requires deeper expertise and escalate it promptly to a senior engineer or subject matter expert, providing a clear summary of the issue, investigation performed, and findings.
* Collaborate with senior engineers, developers, product specialists, and other support teams to resolve customer issues.
* Learn and apply established troubleshooting processes, simulation best practices, and customer support procedures.
* Create and update technical documentation, troubleshooting notes, frequently asked questions, and knowledge\-base content for customers and internal teams.
* Perform data manipulation, preparation, validation, and analysis tasks as required to support technical investigations, knowledge development, and customer support operations.
* Submit product improvement suggestions and defect reports when appropriate, following established processes and with guidance from senior team members.
* Assist with verification of product fixes and application testing of new product releases, as assigned.
* Use available resources, including AI\-based support platforms, responsibly and effectively to complement engineering analysis and improve support quality.
* Continuously develop technical expertise in one or more structural simulation areas.
* Build an understanding of Japanese customers’ engineering workflows, business expectations, and communication requirements.
* Contribute to high customer satisfaction through responsiveness, professionalism, teamwork, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Participate in other team and company initiatives as needed.
* Remain flexible and open to new responsibilities based on business and customer needs.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Sound academic or practical knowledge of structural mechanics and finite element analysis.
* Basic understanding of numerical simulation methods and the ability to interpret engineering results.
* Demonstrated logical problem\-solving skills and the ability to investigate technical issues systematically.
* Ability to communicate fluently and effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate technical information clearly to customers and colleagues.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in India, Japan, and other global locations.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance or escalating issues when appropriate.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Customer\-focused mindset, professional conduct, and willingness to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Engineering curiosity and a strong commitment to continuous learning.
* Ability to work effectively across different cultures, locations, and time zones.
* Willingness to work hours that provide reasonable coverage and collaboration with the Japan support team, subject to applicable company policies and local employment requirements.


 Who You Are
   

  

* 0\-2 Years of experience using structural simulation, finite element analysis, or related engineering software. Relevant university research, academic projects, internships, or industrial experience may be considered.
* Experience using commercial or internally developed FEA software for engineering applications.
* Familiarity with structural analysis workflows, including linear or nonlinear analysis.
* Experience in a technical support, customer\-facing, consulting, application engineering, or engineering services environment.
* Japanese\-language proficiency.
* Experience communicating or collaborating with customers or colleagues in Japan.
* Basic knowledge of Python, scripting, automation, SQL, databases, machine learning, or generative AI.
* Experience participating in an engineering product development or software testing cycle.
* Willingness to travel occasionally, if required.


 The Team You'll Be Part Of
   

  

 You will be part of the Synopsys Customer Excellence team, a global group of engineers focused on making customers successful with Synopsys simulation software. The team works across time zones and technical domains, supporting customers through their toughest engineering challenges and helping drive adoption of Synopsys Structural Products. You will collaborate closely with colleagues who share your commitment to solving hard problems and delivering high\-quality support.
   

  

 Rewards and Benefits
   

  

 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: AO/RFP Writer - Fixed Income
description:
**Job Description**
*AllianceBernstein’s Client Group has a presence in the Americas, Europe, Asia and Australia, and is composed of five main areas:*
* Sales \& Client Services works with financial intermediaries and institutions to offer diversified investment solutions that help clients build and preserve their wealth
* Business Development is a conduit to the firm’s investment teams and supports our clients and internal business partners through investment\-platform and product content, messaging, competitive analysis and education
* Product Strategy \& Development designs, develops and manages the firm’s global lineup of investment services and considers clients’ evolving needs to identify new opportunities
* Marketing promotes the firm and its services by creating, packaging and distributing content and messaging to engage diverse audiences through digital platforms and initiatives, strategic campaigns, and events
* Business Transformation looks to evolve and scale our business, leveraging digital and data, to drive top\-line growth and improve profitability


**What You’ll Do**
*AllianceBernstein’s Request for Proposal (RFP) team is in search of a RFP writer to contribute to business development and client service through the completion of RFPs, RFIs, as well as some due diligence requests for AllianceBernstein’s Fixed Income Strategies. The Writer will specialize in writing RFPs for our Fixed Income Strategies in a timely and accurate manner, while also contributing, where needed, to the completion of other projects and requests. The Writer will be expected to be able to work effectively with the firm’s Senior RFP Writers and Management Team, Product Managers and Portfolio Managers, as well as our Sales Teams, to write and maintain (keep updated) original and technical product\-specific content to support our Fixed Income platform, and, importantly, to be able to effectively customize that content for specific sales situations as needed.*
*This position will provide an opportunity to develop knowledge in the entire new business development process: from the initial screening of an RFP, to the organization and project management of an RFP, to the actual content creation and updating of RFP language and then, finally, to the follow\-up and tracking of our RFPs. The candidate will be expected to handle a high volume of requests simultaneously and productively. Projects will be primarily related to new business opportunities, as well as some client servicing\-related including Onboarding Questionnaires and client Due Diligence Questionnaires.*
**Specific Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Write a high volume of RFPs for Fixed Income strategies and support other asset classes as needed.
* Liaise with various departments throughout the firm to collect information needed to respond to requests, including but not limited to portfolio management, product management/marketing, legal, operations, AUM reporting and performance.
* Create and maintain RFP language and content for assigned strategies of coverage, including investment process, research process, team information, and competitive advantages.
* Maintain consistent product messaging and updated product language in our RFP database.
* Collaborate directly with Product Managers, Portfolio Managers, Research Analysts, Traders, and others to update existing RFP language and develop new language.
* Customize final documents to reflect a nuanced and targeted response to the specific sales opportunity.
* Handle follow\-up work associated with RFPs moving to the next phase: coordinating answers, additional information, etc.
* Oversee production of final proposals (formatting, technical editing and reproduction).
* Coordinate multiple projects simultaneously to meet strict deadlines.
* Field ad\-hoc questions from our Client Response Center Team daily, as needed.


**What We’re Looking For**
*The ideal candidate should have:*
* Knowledge of the broader fixed income market and the asset management industry.
* Detail\-oriented with excellent project management and organizational skills; able to prioritize work and handle multiple tasks to ensure that complex projects are completed by deadline, with interim review steps incorporated.
* Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills as well as the ability to work independently and as part of a team in a large global organization.
* Demonstrated desire and ability to learn technical info, including philosophy, research and investment processes of our products.
* Demonstrated initiative and good judgment as well as the ability to work well under pressure and with time constraints.
* Interest in and ability to interact directly and effectively with Sales Advisors, Portfolio Managers and other investment professionals.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Word, and possess the ability to quickly master internal systems and applications.
* Experience: 5\-8 years of RFP and industry experience required. Direct experience with Fixed Income RFP content is required.
* Education: CFA Level I cleared \& MBA Finance


**About AB**
*We are a leading global investment management firm offering high\-quality research and diversified investment services to institutional clients, retail investors, and private\-wealth clients in major markets around the globe. With over 4,000 employees across 57 locations operating in 26 countries and jurisdictions, our ambition is simple: to be the most trusted investment firm in the world. We realize that it's our people who give us a competitive advantage and drive success in the market, and our goal is to create an inclusive culture that rewards hard work.*
*Our culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration creates an environment where you can thrive and do your best work. Whether you're producing thought\-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business or providing thoughtful advice to our clients, we are fully invested in you. If you're ready to challenge your limits and empower your career, join us!*
***Location:***
*Pune, India*
 Pune, India

description:

 **TechResearch.**

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration\-1
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration supports strategic payroll initiatives, including mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), P\&C Modernization programs, system implementations, and process improvement efforts. This role serves as a key execution resource responsible for coordinating testing activities, validating payroll and employee data, supporting implementation readiness, and assisting with solution deployments across payroll operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 M\&A Integration Support
   

  

* Support payroll workstreams during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and organizational restructures.
* Assist with payroll integration planning and execution activities.
* Coordinate employee data collection, validation, and migration activities.
* Prepare implementation documentation and integration trackers.
* Support payroll readiness assessments and integration milestones.
* Monitor project tasks, risks, issues, and action items.
* Assist in stabilization activities following acquisitions.


 P\&C Modernization Implementation Support
   

  

* Participate in payroll\-related activities supporting Workday and P\&C Modernization initiatives.
* Support configuration validation and business process testing.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to evaluate payroll impacts of system changes.
* Coordinate payroll requirements gathering and documentation.
* Support process redesign and standardization initiatives.


 Testing \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Execute end\-to\-end payroll testing activities for system implementations and enhancements.
* Develop and assist with unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), parallel payroll testing, regression testing
* Validate payroll calculations and outputs.
* Reconcile testing results and identify variances.
* Document, track, and help resolve defects.
* Verify successful implementation of payroll requirements.


 Process Improvement \& Documentation
   

  

* Create and maintain standard test scripts, process documentation, standard operating procedures
* Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes and implementation methodologies.
* Contribute to payroll implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Support operational readiness reviews.


 Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Collaborate with Payroll Operations, P\&C teams, Benefits, Technology teams, Third\-party payroll providers
* Participate in project meetings and provide implementation status updates.
* Escalate risks, issues, and testing concerns as necessary.
* Support communication and change management activities.


 Post\-Go\-Live Stabilization
   

  

* Assist with issue resolution following implementations.
* Monitor payroll processing and implementation outcomes.
* Validate corrective actions and system fixes.
* Transition completed solutions to operational payroll teams.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of payroll, payroll implementation, or payroll operations experience.
* Experience supporting payroll system implementations or upgrades.
* Understanding of payroll processes, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with testing methodologies and issue management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Experience supporting M\&A integrations.
* Experience with Workday, ADP, or other payroll platforms.
* Experience participating in large\-scale HR or payroll transformation programs.
* Knowledge of payroll compliance, tax, benefits, and time management processes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The team develops programs, research, resources, and experiences that support families as they communicate across generations, prepare rising leaders, define shared goals, and make thoughtful decisions about wealth, legacy, governance, and family continuity.

title: Pega Business Architect / Analyst - VOIS
description:

 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.

 We are seeking an experienced Pega Business Architect / Business Analyst to lead requirements discovery, process design, and delivery governance for Pega Business Process Management (BPM) and Case Management implementations. Based in Pune with a hybrid working model requiring office attendance two days per week, this role will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, translating operational transformation objectives into scalable Pega workflow solutions. The position is ideally suited to professionals with strong expertise in Pega BPM, process modelling, stakeholder engagement, and Agile delivery environments.

 Collaborate with Pega architects and developers to ensure workflow designs align with platform best practices, case management capabilities, and enterprise architecture standards.

 Define and govern business rules, decision tables, decision trees, routing logic, and escalation workflows.
   

  

 Maintain end\-to\-end traceability from business requirements through design, testing, and deployment.

 Experience of 5\+ years in enterprise IT and business analysis, including 4\+ years focused on Pega implementations.
   

  

 Strong functional expertise in Pega BPM and Case Management, including case design, stages, processes, SLAs, work parties, and routing.
   

  

 Proficiency in BPMN process modelling and translating business processes into effective Pega case designs.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Pega decisioning capabilities including decision tables, decision trees, and when rules.
   

  

 Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies, ideally SAFe, with exposure to Scrum and Kanban practices.

 Opportunity to shape enterprise\-wide business transformation programmes through Pega BPM and Case Management solutions.
   

  

 Exposure to multi\-market and global stakeholder environments.
   

  

 Hybrid working model based in Pune.
   

  

 Opportunity to collaborate with business leaders, architects, product teams, and technology specialists across complex programmes.
   

  

 Involvement in strategic process improvement, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Exposure to emerging technologies including low\-code platforms, automation, and AI\-enabled workflows.

 Advanced Pega BPM and Case Management design practices.
   

  

 Enterprise\-scale process modelling and workflow transformation techniques.
   

  

 Fit\-gap analysis and business architecture methodologies.
   

  

 Agile and SAFe delivery governance approaches.
   

  

 End\-to\-end requirements traceability and business analysis best practices.

 Define the needed business cases with project team and process owner, defining business outcomes, including current baseline and future target metrics, such as leading and lagging indicators, and linking to strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).

title: Project Sr Analyst - C12 - PUNE
description:
Organization Overview:
   

  

 We are a dynamic, global, and diverse Organization, with a presence in over 60 Countries; covering all front post execution Operations teams including product aligned Middle Office groups, Settlements, Margin, Asset Servicing, Listed Derivative \& Commodities Operations. We support an extensive range of Capital Markets products and services including Fixed Income (FX, Rates, Credit, Muni, Cash and Derivatives) where Citi is consistently a dominant top 3 player in the market, Equity (Cash, Derivatives, Prime Brokerage, Futures, Listed Derivatives, FXPB) where Citi has a significant growth program to continue to build out its capabilities and services; and Syndicates where we support both FI and EQ new issues and IPOs.
   

  

 We take pride and are passionate about our People and our culture. We are invested in our People and their development. We are transforming and simplifying our operating model, creating an exciting environment which encourages diversity of thought and inclusion.
   

  

 Our Operations groups are core to the success of the Markets business and have significant impact across the lifecycle of a trade. We partner extensively with a range of internal stakeholders including Front Office Sales and Trading Desks, Compliance, Legal, Finance and HR; alongside having significant interaction with our external client base, playing a key role in the overall client experience. We have a Client relationship group, dedicated to overseeing the Organizational service performance and strategic partnership for our top tier client base, where we play a key role in supporting our global clients to ensure they have a first\-class experience when doing business with Citi.
   

  

 Our Business Intelligence and Process Re\-engineering group works alongside our Operations teams delivering automation solutions to solve for operational challenges. We partner with Citi’s innovation labs to drive optimization, and overall play a pivotal role in enabling us to transform to achieve our target operating model.
   

  

 Our Technology partners develop and implement a wide range of applications that support the Operations, Change, Design and Implementation groups in providing innovative products and solutions. We have re\-imagined how to provide technology and service in our domain through the alignment of our team vision, culture, and aggressive retirement plan for legacy applications and adoption of a micro\-based containerized cloud environment. We encourage our people to create, explore and be adventurous whilst taking measured risk, adopting safe practices to protect the firm. Data lineage and optimization is core to how we develop our eco system. We are growing our capabilities using artificial intelligence, natural language processing and machine learning.
   

  

 Our roles entail ensuring we operate in a robust control environment, whilst in a fast\-paced workplace. We comply with global regulations and internal policies and adopt a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to reduce risk through the continuous evaluation of our controls; to protect our clients, the firm, and our reputation.
   

  

 We work closely with our external global peers, partners, and regulators, and play an integral part in leading an agenda at the forefront to optimize and streamline processes and drive strategy across our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 The Markets Process Engineering team has been formed to support stakeholders both within Operations and across the bank, to design and deliver a multi\-year transformation roadmap. Our transformation is underpinned by strategy, investment change execution and a market leading change delivery team focusing on program and project management, business analysis, process re\-engineering and low code application development.
   

  

 The Futures and OTC Clearing franchise is an agency business providing trading and clearing capabilities across 40\+ exchanges to our clients and proprietary lines of business such as Equities, Rates, Commodities, FX and Prime D1\. The business is embarking on a strategic re\-engineering of its platforms. This is a multi\-year initiative, moving to real\-time computation, and with ambitious goals to design and deliver a more robust, strategic, well controlled end state for Futures and OTC Clearing Operations.
   

  

 We are recruiting for a Project/Business Analyst to help lead the delivery of strategic initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join a growing, global, and dynamic change management team, delivering a major Tier 1 program.
   

  

 The role will work in partnership with the Futures and OTC clearing business, global operations teams, technology and downstream areas such as finance and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The core responsibilities of the Project Manager and Business Analyst include but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Develop and manage project plans, define project scope, goals, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements to ensure successful project execution.
* Manage project lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring that project deliverables are met and proper evidence provided.
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, and dependencies, developing and implementing effective mitigation and contingency plans.
* Create and maintain project documentation, including project charters, requirements, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Facilitate and lead project meetings, including kick\-offs, status updates, working groups and governance forums, to ensure clear and consistent communication among all project participants.
* Conduct business and data analysis to document business and operational processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop and maintain detailed process maps, use cases to support business and functional requirements
* Analyze existing business processes to identify opportunities for improvement, and assist in designing enhanced workflows
* Coordinate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure that developed solutions meet business requirements and are fit for purpose.
* Prepare senior level presentations to communicate project updates
* Collaborate with stakeholders across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance and other functions to ensure successful project implementation.


**Qualifications:**
* Project Management and Business Analysis experience
* Exchange Traded Derivatives (ETD) Regulatory Reporting knowledge is a plus
* 2\-3 years operations experience (preferably in banking)
* Critical thinking and problem solving
* Strong ability in use of Microsoft Applications (PowerPoint, Visio, Project, Word, Excel, Access)
* Proficient with the project life cycle (Waterfall \& Agile)
* CAPM, PMP, PgMP and/or MBA are a plus
* Developed communication and diplomacy skills required to persuade and influence others; may negotiate with external parties.


**Role Overview:**
 The role we are recruiting for is a hybrid Business Analyst / Project Manager role aligned to the Equities business. You will be part of the Futures \& Derivatives Clearing (FDC) and Equities Operations Program Execution Team, a key component of the Markets Ops Transformation organization. The team drives strategic transformation and delivers Target Operating Models for FDC and Equities Operations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Project Leadership \& Delivery: Manage end\-to\-end projects from defining scope, milestones and deliverables with stakeholders to ensuring successful, on\-time delivery meeting business needs.
* Planning \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business requirements, plans, and risk/issue logs.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Monitor project progress, resources, and risks, identifying and escalating issues promptly and providing timely, clear updates and presentations to all stakeholders, including senior management.
* Process Optimization: Lead business analysis efforts, clarify requirements, and drive the development and implementation of innovative, efficient processes for Equities Operations.
* Risk \& Compliance: Apply robust risk management practices and ensure regulatory compliance to protect the firm's reputation.
* Team \& Collaboration: Drive resource planning and foster strong cross\-functional collaboration across Business, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other departments.
* Strategic Initiatives: Champion change management and undertake additional strategic projects/tasks as required.

title: Electronic Systems Product Specialist
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
 Investigates electronic application and systems problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Applies and improves electronic application and systems development processes and tools. Processes include system specification, modeling and simulation, calibration, Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP\&R), and troubleshooting. Application of tools for simulation, calibration, and product life maintenance required. Obtains input from customers, technical and product teams, manufacturing engineers, supplier partners, and other stakeholders to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Makes decisions in the areas of electronic and electrical system design, requirements, calibration, and test that impact the quality and performance of calibrated subsystems and feature classes of electronic subsystems. Responsible for review of less\-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient design. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Design and Application of Mechatronics Systems \- Specifies electronic hardware and interconnections that measure and control systems; applies electronic hardware and interconnections in Cummins' products.
   

  

 Machine Integration and Optimization \- Combines various parts or sub\-systems into a whole to achieve the output most desired by the customer; applies Cummins' installation requirements using our standard tools, processes and identified best practices to ensure optimization of performance, reliability, cost and quality; analyzes technical issues using proven problem\-solving and troubleshooting techniques for rapid resolution.
   

  

 Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis \- Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub\-system and/or component level requirements.
   

  

 Product Problem Solving \- Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data\-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
   

  

 Product Verification and Validation Management \- Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
   

  

 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Systems Thinking \- Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
   

  

 Builds networks \- Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

 Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls \- Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
   

  

 Post\-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Provide technical and application engineering support to Mining and Construction OEMs by understanding customer requirements, supporting engine and electronic system integration, managing calibration\-related activities, and ensuring successful execution of customer projects. The role serves as the primary technical interface between OEM customers and Cummins cross\-functional teams throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Act as the primary technical contact for Industrial Markets segments Construction and Mining OEM customers.
* Work closely with OEMs to understand vehicle/equipment requirements and translate them into Cummins engine and system requirements.
* Support application engineering activities for Industrial Markets segments mining and Construction projects from concept through production.
* Review customer requirements and identify engine, aftertreatment, and electronic control system impacts.
* Coordinate with Product Engineering, Calibration, Controls, and Systems teams to define and implement required changes.
* Identify calibration requirements and support calibration development, validation, and deployment activities.
* Support engine electronic system integration, including ECM configuration and troubleshooting.
* Provide expertise on CAN communication architecture, J1939 communication protocols, and electronic system interfaces.
* Support OEM harness design, electrical integration, and validation activities.
* Review customer electrical schematics and ensure compliance with Cummins integration guidelines.
* Manage product releases, documentation updates, and engineering change activities through Cummins PLM processes.
* Support project planning, milestone tracking, issue resolution, and customer deliverables.
* Participate in customer meetings, technical reviews, validation activities, and field issue investigations.
* Support new product introductions and ongoing product improvement initiatives within the Mining and Construction segments.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of diesel engine systems and engine electronics.
* Experience with Engine Control Modules (ECM) and electronic engine controls.
* Knowledge of CAN communication protocols (J1939 preferred).
* Experience in OEM electrical harness design and development.
* Understanding of engine integration, controls, sensors, and actuators.
* Familiarity with calibration processes and change management activities.
* Experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and engineering release processes.
* Ability to interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
* Knowledge of Mining and Construction equipment applications is preferred.
* Understanding of product validation, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis methodologies.


 Behavioral Competencies
   

  

* Customer focus and relationship management.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Project management and execution discipline.
* Cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.
* Problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting Industrial Markets segments Mining, Construction, Off\-Highway, or Industrial OEM customers.
* Prior experience with Cummins engine platforms, controls, and electronic systems is highly desirable.

title: AI Services Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
 Why This Role? Why Now?
   

  

 Customer experience is transforming through AI\-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change — we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionizing how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology. As the technical and product expert for our AI\-powered Resolution Platform, the AI Services Consultant role is integral to delivering quick time to value while guiding our customers through their configuration and optimization.
   

  

 Mission
   

  

 As an AI Services Consultant at Zendesk, your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. You will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex configurations with agility and precision. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure seamless integration and optimization of AI solutions, driving transformative business outcomes.
   

  

**Overarching Objective For The Role**

* Lead smooth, on\-time delivery. Run projects end\-to\-end with clear scope, timelines, and stakeholder alignment to deliver reliably.

* Technical Expertise \& Guidance: Provide expert advice on the implementation and optimization of Zendesk AI products, ensuring customers leverage the full capabilities of the technology to meet their business goals.
* Change Management \& Training: Facilitate change management processes and deliver consultative sessions to ensure smooth adoption and integration of AI solutions within customer organizations.
* Successful Project Delivery: Accountable for the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, meeting or exceeding customer expectations and maintaining high standards of quality.
* Customer Satisfaction: Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, contributing to customer retention and potential upsell opportunities.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams, including Customer Success and Sales, to ensure alignment on the customer’s AI Roadmap and address any technical challenges that would block the customer from adopting AI.
* Tactical solutions for business outcomes: Ensure that AI solutions are effectively aligned with customer business goals, resulting in measurable improvements in customer experience and AI Adoption.


 What You’ll Need to Succeed
   

  

 Strategic Skills \& Expertise
   

  

* Consulting Expertise: Strong consulting skills with the ability to assess client needs, develop strategic solutions, and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.
* Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Project Management: Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of AI projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and meet quality standards.
* Technical Proficiency in AI: Deep understanding of AI technologies, particularly Zendesk AI products, with the ability to implement and optimize these solutions effectively.
* Agility and Adaptability: Ability to work effectively in diverse and dynamic environments, adapting to changing client needs and industry trends.
* Problem\-Solving Abilities: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify challenges and develop innovative solutions.
* Continuous Learning: Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends and advancements, ensuring the delivery of cutting\-edge solutions to clients.


**Qualifications**
* Must have a minimum of 3\+ years of related experience in Consulting / Professional Services
* Previous experience in go\-to\-customer/GTM roles in enterprise technology / SaaS — either customer success management, professional services/consulting, technical account management, or solutions engineering/pre\-sales consulting

* Demonstrated experience designing and executing success plans or roadmaps that drive measurable customer outcomes
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Experience managing AI or software adoption programs with demonstrated impact on business metrics such as retention or satisfaction.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degrees; certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred.
* Certifications in AI strategy or project management preferred
* Excellent program management and cross\-functional influence skills
* Familiarity with emerging AI trends is a plus
* Ability to distill complex AI concepts for diverse audiences, especially executive stakeholders


 AIAA
   

  

 Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
   

  

 Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration \- while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in\-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.
   

  

**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
 Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
   

  

 Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. title: Manager / Assistant Manager - Estimation
description:
**About Zeeco**
 Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, delivering innovative technologies for the refining, petrochemical, chemical, LNG, power, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our portfolio includes process burners, power burners, boiler burners, duct burners, thermal oxidizers, flares, vapor recovery systems, incinerators, and combustion control systems. With engineering and manufacturing facilities across the globe, Zeeco provides customized combustion solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and environmental compliance.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Zeeco is seeking an experienced
 **Senior Estimation Engineer** 
 with
 **10 to 15\+ years of experience** 
 in preparing techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner systems. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of combustion equipment, burner management systems, instrumentation, mechanical equipment, and project costing.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for reviewing customer enquiries, interpreting technical specifications, coordinating with engineering and procurement teams, obtaining vendor quotations, developing accurate cost estimates, and preparing competitive technical and commercial proposals for global projects.
   

  

 Candidates with either a
 **Mechanical Engineering** 
 or
 **Instrumentation \& Control Engineering** 
 background and extensive experience in industrial combustion equipment are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**RFQ \& Technical Review**
* Review customer RFQs, ITBs, specifications, datasheets, PFDs, P\&IDs, burner schedules, and other project documents.
* Evaluate process requirements, fuel characteristics, combustion duty, control philosophy, emissions, and applicable design standards.
* Identify technical clarifications, scope gaps, deviations, and commercial risks before proposal submission.


**Estimation \& Costing**
* Prepare accurate techno\-commercial estimates for industrial burner packages.
* Develop Bills of Materials (BOM) covering burners, fuel trains, BMS/CCS, PLC/HMI, instrumentation, valves, electrical, mechanical, and bought\-out items.
* Estimate engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, logistics, commissioning, and documentation costs.


**Vendor \& Proposal Management**
* Obtain and evaluate vendor quotations for technical compliance, pricing, and delivery.
* Coordinate with procurement to optimize vendor selection and project costing.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals, including cost sheets, assumptions, exclusions, and deviations.


**Engineering Coordination**
* Coordinate with Mechanical, Process, Electrical, Instrumentation, Procurement, and Manufacturing teams to validate technical and commercial inputs.
* Review engineering deliverables such as P\&IDs, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and instrument schedules to support accurate estimation.


**Cost Optimization \& Bid Support**
* Identify value engineering opportunities and cost\-effective technical solutions while ensuring compliance with customer specifications.
* Support customer clarification meetings, bid evaluations, negotiations, and project handover following order award.


**Estimation Database**
* Maintain estimation databases, standard costing, historical pricing, and vendor cost records to improve estimation accuracy and proposal competitiveness.


**Technical Expertise**
**The ideal candidate should possess strong knowledge of:**
**Combustion Systems**
* Process, Boiler, Power, and Duct Burners
* Low NOx, Ultra Low NOx, Gas, Oil, Dual\-Fuel, and Multi\-Fuel Burners
* Burner sizing, fuel selection, combustion principles, and emissions requirements


**Fuel Train \& Mechanical Systems:**
* Fuel gas and liquid fuel trains
* Pressure regulators, safety shut\-off valves, control valves, vent valves, filters, and strainers
* Burners, dampers, registers, skid\-mounted systems, piping, and fabricated assemblies


**Instrumentation \& Controls:**
* Burner Management Systems (BMS) and Combustion Control Systems (CCS)
* PLC/HMI\-based control systems
* Flame scanners, ignition systems, pressure, temperature, and flow instrumentation
* Control valves, actuators, and combustion safety interlocks


**Estimation \& Proposal Engineering:**
* Interpretation of RFQs, P\&IDs, datasheets, burner schedules, and technical specifications
* Preparation of Bills of Materials (BOM), vendor enquiries, techno\-commercial evaluations, and detailed cost estimates
* Cost optimization, value engineering, and proposal preparation for industrial burner packages


**Codes \& Standards:**
 Working knowledge of applicable combustion and industrial standards, including
 **NFPA 85/86** 
 ,
 **API** 
 ,
 **ASME** 
 ,
 **IEC** 
 , and
 **ISA is preferred.**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Instrumentation \& Control Engineering.
* 10–15 years of experience in estimation, proposal engineering, or applications engineering for industrial combustion systems.
* Experience working with burner OEMs, combustion equipment manufacturers, EPC companies, or industrial heating solution providers.


**Preferred Industry Background**
* Industrial Burner Manufacturers
* Combustion Equipment OEMs
* Boiler Manufacturers
* Process Heater OEMs
* Furnace Manufacturers
* Oil \& Gas
* Petrochemical
* Refining
* Power Generation
* EPC Organizations
* Industrial Heating Equipment Manufacturers


**Desired Competencies**
* Strong techno\-commercial acumen.
* Excellent understanding of combustion systems and process heating applications.
* Ability to interpret complex customer specifications and translate them into accurate cost estimates.
* Strong analytical and cost modelling skills.
* Excellent negotiation and vendor management capabilities.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* Ability to manage multiple enquiries with tight bid submission deadlines.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Self\-driven with a strong focus on accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement.

title: Tech Writer
description:
**Job Description**
**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

**Work Schedule:** 
 Standard (Monday\-Friday)
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a skilled Technical Writer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing a variety of technical documentation, including user manuals, operating instructions, online help, release notes, product data sheets, and installation instructions.
   

  

 This role provides opportunities to work with global cross\-functional product teams and gain deep knowledge of enterprise software products and technologies. You will strengthen your expertise in technical communication, content strategy, and modern documentation tools while contributing to large\-scale product releases.
   

  

 The position offers exposure to global stakeholders, enabling you to enhance your collaboration, leadership, and project management skills.
   

  

 This position is challenging and rewarding for writers who enjoy working with innovative and creative technology products.
   

  

 Writers work in a comfortable, respectful environment and are treated as peers across departments. Technical documentation is required and valued as part of most products. Each writer’s role is important to the writing team’s contribution and the overall success of those products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Job Responsibilities**
* Create and maintain high\-quality technical documentation, including product data sheet, user guides, installation manuals, release notes for software and hardware products based on the Client’s Framework.
* Learn and work with Client’s software and hardware products.
* Understand client’s customer personas and their specific needs.
* Refer demos, videos and anything else that helps to collect pieces of information to develop technical documents.
* Write task\-based topics with related concepts and reference topics as needed.
* Define content strategy and architecture at the product level based on collected technical publication plan.
* Develop technical documents from scratch by gathering requirements, structuring content, and ensuring accuracy and completeness.
* Collaborate with engineers, developers, product managers, offering managers, and subject matter experts to collect, validate, and update technical information.
* Collaborate with other Technical Writers (client team) in a team environment.
* Follow client Style Guide and workflow standards for authoring, review, and publishing.
* Review and check documents as per approved templates, checklist, and set standards.
* Communicate and arrange reviews/approvals from global stakeholders.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Mechanical, Instrumentation, or E\&TC engineering streams \- Preferred
* Bachelor’s degree in related engineering discipline or science\-related field
* Bachelor’s Degree in technical writing, communications, engineering, journalism, English, technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.


**Qualifications**
**Background**
**You Must Have**
* 3\+ years of experience in the technical writing domain.
* Proven experience in creating technical documents from scratch, including planning, structuring, writing, and publishing content.
* Proficiency in Darwin Information Typing Architecture (DITA) \- mandatory.
* Must have hands\-on experience using documentation tools \- Adobe FrameMaker, Microsoft Office, Adobe InDesign, and/or AEM Guides.
* Must have hands\-on experience using collaboration tools \- Jira, and Confluence.
* Sophisticated knowledge of structured authoring and single sourcing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including native\-level competency in English.
* Capability to quickly learn complex technical concepts \& product technicalities.
* Requires occasional flexibility in working hours to effectively collaborate with global stakeholders in meetings aligned with the Eastern Standard Time (EST) time zone.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly
* Good time management \& prioritization of assigned tasks \& projects.
* Demonstrated attention to detail.
* Reliably self\-motivated and comfortable working independently.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience in technical documentation of Building Management Systems, Network controllers, building controls, security systems, industrial controls, data centers, or energy management tools and controls.
* Experience with AI tools and their use for content generation, review, and migration.
* Leverage generative AI and content intelligence tools to improve documentation development, review, migration, and maintenance processes.
* Use AI\-assisted technologies responsibly to accelerate content creation while ensuring technical accuracy, consistency, and compliance with documentation standards.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve content discoverability, customer self\-service experiences, and knowledge management through AI\-powered solutions.
* Contribute to the adoption of modern documentation practices such as AI\-assisted authoring, content reuse, metadata optimization, and intelligent search
* Demonstrate an understanding of the responsible use of generative AI for documentation, including content generation, editing, summarization, migration, quality review, metadata enrichment, and knowledge management.
* Familiarity with writing for localization material.


**About Us**
 The Building Automation group at Honeywell Technologies specializes in delivering advanced solutions that enhance building performance, efficiency, and safety. Our mission is to integrate cutting\-edge technologies and intelligent systems that provide real\-time data and analytics, aimed at optimizing energy use, increasing occupant comfort, and ensuring the sustainability of built environments. We leverage innovative practices and collaborate with partners to develop smart building solutions that meet the evolving needs of clients in a rapidly changing global landscape.
   

  

**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Associate - Technical Content | HigherEducation
description:
**upGrad Private Limited \- www.upgrad.com** 




  





**About Us \-** 




 upGrad is an online education platform building the careers of tomorrow by offering the most industry\-relevant programs in an immersive learning experience. Our mission is to create a new digital\-first learning experience to deliver tangible career impact to individuals at scale. upGrad currently offers programs in Data Science, Machine Learning, Product Management, Digital Marketing, and Entrepreneurship, etc. upGrad is looking for people passionate about management and education to help design learning programs for working professionals to stay sharp and stay relevant and help build the careers of tomorrow.
 



  





**Designation** 
 – Associate \- Technical Content (HigherEducation)
 



**Work Location** 
 – Pune
 



**Work Mode** 
 – In\-Office
 



  





**Job Overview \-** 




 We are looking for a technically strong, deeply curious
 **Associate \- Technical Content Research \& Learning** 
 to work closely with the creator. This is not a traditional social\-media or YouTube\-operations role. The primary responsibility is to research technical topics deeply, identify what is worth teaching, and help convert complex engineering concepts into accurate, engaging, and pedagogically sound content. The role will span three areas:
 **Technical Content Research for YouTube, Content Strategy and Curriculum Planning** 
 , and designing the learning journey for learners who move from videos into structured courses on the LMS. The ideal candidate should have excellent hands\-on command of DSA, strong software\-engineering fundamentals, and the curiosity to independently understand unfamiliar systems and technologies.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities \-** 




**Technical Content Research \-** 



* Research DSA, software engineering, system design, backend, databases, distributed systems, AI engineering, and other relevant technology topics for upcoming videos.
* Go beyond surface\-level internet research: read documentation, engineering blogs, papers, codebases, interview discussions, benchmarks, and credible technical sources to build accurate context.
* Break down difficult concepts from first principles and identify the misconceptions, edge cases, examples, analogies, and practical insights that would make a topic genuinely useful to learners.
* Validate technical accuracy of ideas, examples, code snippets, diagrams, and claims before they are used in content.
* Build research briefs for each video containing the core question, audience confusion, key concepts, examples, counter\-intuitive insights, references, and recommended teaching flow.



  





**Content Strategy \& Ideation \-** 



* Identify high\-value topics based on learner problems, interview preparation needs, software\-engineering relevance, emerging technology shifts, and gaps in existing educational content.
* Help build weekly and monthly content calendars across DSA, System Design / Software Engineering, and AI Engineering.
* Study strong technology educators, creators, courses, communities, and content formats to understand what makes technical education clear, engaging, and differentiated.
* Work with the creator to turn research into strong video ideas, hooks, outlines, series, and long\-term content pillars without compromising technical depth.
* Use YouTube performance data and learner feedback to identify which topics, explanations, formats, and series should be expanded, changed, or discontinued.



  





**Learning Design \& LMS Pedagogy \-** 



* Design the learning journey for students who discover a topic on YouTube and continue learning it on the LMS.
* Convert broad topics into structured modules, lessons, prerequisites, practice exercises, checkpoints, assignments, projects, and revision paths.
* Design pedagogy that moves learners from intuition to understanding to implementation to practice, rather than simply organising a collection of videos.
* Create or review DSA problem sets, examples, coding exercises, concept checks, and assessments aligned with the learning objective of each module.
* Identify where learners are likely to struggle and design scaffolding, hints, worked examples, prerequisite refreshers, and progressive difficulty accordingly.
* Ensure continuity between free YouTube content and deeper LMS learning so that the transition feels natural and valuable.



  





**Collaboration \& Execution \-** 



* Work closely with the creator during ideation, research, outlining, and curriculum design.
* Coordinate with video editors, designers, platform teams, or other collaborators when technical context is needed for execution.
* Maintain organised research repositories, source lists, topic backlogs, curriculum documents, and content calendars.
* Stay consistently curious about new engineering ideas, tools, architectures, research, and discussions across the software industry.



  





**What We Are Looking For \-** 



* Excellent hands\-on understanding of Data Structures \& Algorithms. You should be comfortable solving problems, explaining multiple approaches, analysing time and space complexity, and teaching the reasoning behind a solution.
* Strong computer\-science and software\-engineering fundamentals. Familiarity with areas such as operating systems, databases, networking, backend engineering, APIs, caching, concurrency, and distributed systems is highly desirable.
* Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technical topics independently and go deep enough to explain them accurately.
* Excellent research instincts: you should know how to distinguish a useful primary source from superficial or recycled content.
* Ability to simplify complex topics without oversimplifying or losing technical correctness.
* Strong written communication and structured thinking. You should be able to turn messy research into a clear learning narrative.
* Genuine interest in teaching and understanding how people learn technical subjects.
* High ownership, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and comfort working in an environment where ideas are frequently challenged and improved.



  





**Preferred Background \-** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated technical ability.
* 0\-3 years of experience in software engineering, technical education, competitive programming, developer content, curriculum design, or a closely related field.
* Prior experience with LeetCode / interview\-style DSA, competitive programming, teaching, mentoring, technical blogging, open\-source work, or building software projects will be a strong advantage.
* Experience creating educational content is useful, but deep technical ability and research quality matter more than prior social\-media experience.



  





**This Role May Be a Great Fit If \-** 



* You enjoy spending an hour understanding why a system behaves a certain way rather than stopping at the first explanation you find.
* You can solve a DSA problem and are equally interested in explaining the thought process that leads to the solution.
* You routinely ask questions such as “why does this work?”, “when would this fail?”, “what changes at scale?”, and “how would I teach this to someone seeing it for the first time?”.
* You would enjoy helping build not just individual videos, but an entire technology\-learning ecosystem around a creator\-led channel.



  





**What Success Looks Like \-** 



* Consistently publishes technically accurate, differentiated, and well\-researched content.
* Video ideas are driven by real learner problems and strong technical insight rather than generic trend\-chasing.
* Learners can move naturally from a YouTube video into a structured LMS path that deepens their understanding and gives them meaningful practice.
* Research, curriculum, and content systems become repeatable enough for to scale without reducing quality.



  





**Why Join Us ?** 



* Help build a technology education brand from an early stage and directly influence what and how thousands of engineers learn.
* Work across content, engineering, research, and learning design rather than being restricted to a conventional content role.
* Get significant ownership over research, curriculum, and new learning formats.
* Work on topics across DSA, Software Engineering, System Design, and AI Engineering while continuously deepening your own technical understanding.
